---
name: Agent recommendation feedback
about: Rate, correct, or escalate advice an agent or workflow gave you
title: "[Feedback] "
labels: feedback
assignees: ""
---

## Subject

The target this feedback is about: a named agent (e.g. `hatch3r-implementer`), a workflow or command (e.g. `hatch3r-board-fill`), a specific recommendation, or the framework broadly. Unattributed feedback is not actionable — name one subject.

## Sentiment

One of: `positive` (worked well, keep it) / `negative` (wrong, harmful, or wasteful) / `suggestion` (works, but here is a change).

## What happened (expected vs. actual)

What the agent or workflow did, and what you expected instead. For `negative` or `suggestion`, state the concrete change you want.

## Reproduction context

Anything that makes this self-contained: the issue or PR number, the file path, the command you ran, the hatch3r version. Omit secrets, tokens, internal-only URLs, and proprietary code — this issue is public.

## Additional context

Add any other context here.
